rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the reported 4AA and appropriately cautious about limits of a single image, but it overstates confidence in visible hatching/zona thinning and A-grade TE/ICM detail that are not crisply discernible in this frame.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor, prior IVF failures/miscarriage, sperm factors, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to favorable and unfavorable factors; only minor overreach from morphology inferred beyond the image.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including SET and avoiding unproven add-ons; minor speculative emphasis on hydrosalpinx without confirming its presence prevents a perfect score.
Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, cavity/tubal reassessment, and selective further workup.
